messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Unable to open a cel file ...
parts:
> > cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName(name, chipType=chipType)
> terminate called after throwing an instance of
> 'affymetrix_calvin_exceptions::UnableToOpenFileException'
> Aborted

occurs in the affxparser package and is independent of
aroma.affymetrix. Having said that, it is easier to troubleshoot.
Typically this error occurs when affxparser tries to open/read a CEL
file that is corrupt. Unfortunately, there is no exception handling
in place in affxparser (on the wishlist but not high priority), so you
might experience core dumps :( However, this is extremely rare and is
nothing you should expect.

I suggest that you try to locate the erroneous CEL file. From your
code it should be one in:

rawData/X3/Mapping250K_Nsp/

Try this in a fresh R session:

library(affxparser);
path <- "rawData/X3/Mapping250K_Nsp/";
pathnames <- list.files(path=path, pattern="[.](cel|CEL)$", full.names=TRUE);
for (pathname in pathnames) {
cat("Trying to read: ", pathname, "...\n", sep="");
hdr <- readCelHeader(pathname);
cat("Trying to read: ", pathname, "...done\n", sep="");
}

You will most likely get the exception when you it hits the corrupt CEL file(s).

Hope this helps

/Henrik

Bioconductor since the problem is unrelated to aroma.affymetrix.
Also, make sure to specify the source of the CEL files and if they are
ASCII or binary files. I have one guess that they are ASCII files,
but let's discuss that on BioC help. When you post there, you might
also want to test you can read the files with the 'affyio' package.
